item.title: [HSR 4.6 BETA] Love, Ghosts & Robots Event Info
item.description:
[HSR 4.6 BETA] Love, Ghosts & Robots Event Info

A decommissioned mechatron pipeline, retrofitted by ghost Skott, has somehow become a production line for "Lyndon™ EmbodiMech," capable of giving ghosts physical form! But the one time this old friend decides to do something good, he gets tangled up with the out-of-nowhere arrival of Rakshmi. You and your companions decide to lend a hand, help him pass the assessment, and get him out from under his "rumored girlfriend's" thumb!

◆ Overview ◆
A decommissioned mechatron pipeline, retrofitted by ghost Skott, has somehow become a production line for "Lyndon™ EmbodiMech," capable of giving ghosts physical form! But the one time this old friend decides to do something good, he gets tangled up with the out-of-nowhere arrival of Rakshmi. You and your companions decide to lend a hand, help him pass the assessment, and get him out from under his "rumored girlfriend's" thumb!

◆ Event Rules ◆
● During the event, the Trailblazer will help Skott run a mechatron workshop and try to win a bet against Rakshmi.
● The Trailblazer can take on mechatron orders, install chips to boost mechatron performance, meet client requirements, and earn revenue.
● Throughout the event, four companions will lend their assistance one by one, enabling the Trailblazer to continuously upgrade the pipeline's technology.
● Rakshmi will represent the IPC to evaluate the workshop across 5 assessment cycles. Passing each assessment will level up the workshop.

◆ Permanent Rewards ◆
● Complete more orders to raise your Mechatron Design Level and claim the corresponding rewards.

◆ Limited-time Rewards ◆
Complete limited-time missions during the event period to obtain exclusive rewards.

◆ Event Reminders ◆
● After the "Love, Ghosts & Robots" limited-time event ends, Trailblazers will no longer be able to obtain the limited-time rewards, but they can still visit the Life Sciences Institute map to experience the event and obtain permanent rewards.

Source @FireflyLeak 🌸助推
Ciallo～Nahida | DM/私信 | 助手BOT | 投稿

item.title: [HSR 4.6 BETA] Interastral Peace Gala: One Take Event Info
item.description:
[HSR 4.6 BETA] Interastral Peace Gala: One Take Event Info

Interastral Peace Entertainment's blockbuster reality show, Interastral Peace Gala: One Take, has officially started filming. Audition now, show off your combat skills, and the next action superstar could be you!

◆ Introduction ◆
Interastral Peace Entertainment's blockbuster reality show, Interastral Peace Gala: One Take, has officially started filming. Audition now, show off your combat skills, and the next action superstar could be you!

◆ Event Rules ◆
● After the event starts, a new challenge stage will be unlocked daily, with 5 stages in total.
● Each challenge stage has two difficulties: "Audition" and "Performance." Completing the "Audition" challenge will unlock the "Performance" challenge.
● In challenge stages, Trailblazers can use designated trial characters to participate in the challenge, or swap in the same characters they have.

◆ Gameplay Intro ◆
● In each stage, a different character will be the Lead Actor, fighting alongside Co-Stars and Supporting Actors.
● Each stage features a "Story Setting." Triggering it rapidly accumulates "Highlight Energy," accelerating entry into a "Highlight."
● Entering a "Highlight" activates the corresponding "Script Effect."
● In the "Performance" difficulty, defeating designated waves of enemies before the Cycles end will grant the corresponding "Rating Rewards."
● In the "Performance" difficulty, defeating all waves of enemies before the Cycles end with at least 1 Cycle remaining will earn a "Perfect Curtain Call" rating.
● If the characters you own (Level, Traces, Relics, Eidolons) and their Light Cone levels do not meet the required standards, they will be automatically enhanced by the system, recruiting a mirrored version of the character and Light Cone. This enhancement is only active during the event.

◆ Event Rewards ◆
● During the event, after completing designated challenge goals in the stages, you can claim rewards in "Limited-Time Rewards."
● During the event, after achieving a "Perfect Curtain Call" in all stages, you can claim the Collection Showcase item "Star of Astropolis" Medal in "Commemorative Medals."

Source @FireflyLeak 🌸助推
Ciallo～Nahida | DM/私信 | 助手BOT | 投稿

item.title: [HSR - Future] Finality MC | Imaginary Finality
item.description:
[HSR - Future] Finality MC | Imaginary Finality

NOTE: This is heavily subject to change as it is currently in active development.

**Basic ATK
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to X% of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

Enhanced Basic ATK
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to X% of Trailblazer's ATK to all enemies then deals X instances of Imaginary DMG equal to X% of Trailblazer's ATK to one random enemy (bounce)

Skill
Grants one other designated ally "Finality Invite," increasing their ATK by X% and Break Effect by X%.
While the team is in Burst Mode, "Finality Invite" additionally increases the holder's Burst DMG by X%.
"Finality Invite" only takes effect on the most recent target of Trailblazer's Skill.

Ultimate
Increases SPD of all allies by X% for X turn(s), and increases the Finality Gauge by 100.

Talent
When entering Burst Mode, all Finality characters advance action by 100%.
While in Burst Mode, reduces the DEF of all enemies by X%, increases their Toughness reduction received and enhances Trailblazer's Basic ATK.
The duration of "Finality Invitation" is not reduced while Burst Mode is active, and using Trailblazer's Basic ATK, Skill or Ultimate causes the character with "Finality Invitation" to immediately gain 1 extra turn in which they can insert the use of their Ultimate

Finality/Leader Talent
While Trailblazer is the leader (likely determined by the character that initates combat), using their Basic ATK or Skill increases the Finality Gauge by X. SPD is increased by X% during Burst Mode.
While in Burst Mode, for each instance of DMG dealt by all ally targets, deals 1 additional instance of True DMG equal to X% of the original DMG.
Charge cannot be gained in this way during burst mode

-----

This part is overall for Finality as a path:

Finality Gauge
When there is a Finality character in the team, Finality appears on the action bar (like Aha) where it's speed is affected by the SPD of the Finality Characters in the team (think Aha Instants and Elation characters)
The Finality Gauge is a shared value in the team from 0 to 200 where "burst mode" activates when the value hits 100 or above
Charge can be gained from Finality Characters

NOTE: This section is based on an early interpretation of the mechanic and is subject to change.

Source @FireflyLeak 🌸助推
Ciallo～Nahida | DM/私信 | 助手BOT | 投稿

item.description:
未来王棋骑士关卡Debuff机制一览

以下是该关卡中涉及的关键Debuff效果说明：

* 失忆：我方角色无法召唤忆灵。
* 福来：若我方队伍中包含男角色，每拥有一名男角色，敌人受到的伤害降低20%。
* 刚毅：敌方目标无法被削减，且受到的击破伤害降低50%。
* 绷住：敌方目标受到的欢愉伤害降低50%，且行动条上的“阿哈时刻”消失。
* 出轨：列车组受到的伤害增加100%。
* 不屈：敌方目标受到攻击时，获得相当于生命上限2%的护盾。
* 洞穿：敌方目标释放攻击时，如果受到伤害的我方目标持有护盾，则使敌方目标造成的伤害提高400%。
* 净化：敌方目标回合开始时，解除自身所有持续伤害效果，且受到的持续伤害降低50%。

item.description:
绝密！4.7虚照泄密

4.7虚照·阿哈
基础信息
命途：欢愉
属性：量子
稀有度：五星

特殊能量：“素材” 能量上限30点

普攻：情节发展中。。
对敌方单体造成100%攻击力的量子伤害，获得三层素材。

战技：气氛燃起来了！！
获得“回味”，使我方全体速度提高20%，敌方受到的伤害提高30%三回合，获得三层“素材”。
“回味”：我方每消耗2个战技点，使虚照·阿哈获得一层“素材”，至多通过该效果获得6层“素材”，虚照·阿哈回合开始时刷新触发次数

终结技：经典已成，完稿收工！
虚照·阿哈获得“创作”，同时选定一个角色，使其获得“独家报道”，同时虚照·啊哈自身立刻获得“独家报道”。（消耗15层“素材”）
“创作”：虚照·阿哈技能计算公式中自身好活当赏改为计入我方好活当赏最高的角色的好活当赏。

欢愉技：高光时刻，独家报道！
对敌方全体造成180%的量子欢愉伤害，使敌方全体受到的欢愉伤害提高20%。

天赋：无风险投资
持有好活当赏时，普攻变为相同倍率的欢愉伤害

行迹1：劲爆动漫主理人
虚照·啊哈速度达到160点时，我方全体欢愉度提高20%，达到200点时，我方欢愉度额外提高20%。

行迹2：群像式爆燃
队伍里存在1/2/3/4名欢愉角色时，虚照·阿哈入场获得1/3/4/6层“素材”

行迹3：吃瓜永在第一线
我方除虚照·阿哈以外角色释放两次普攻之后，虚照·阿哈追加一次固定计入20笑点的额外欢愉技。

星魂一：“虚照·阿哈独家爆料”中伤害倍率改为300%，释放5次欢愉技改为3次。
星魂二：虚照·阿哈入场后立刻获得15层“素材”，我方角色获得好活当赏时，使其持续时间延长一回合。
星魂四：队伍中每有一个角色拥有“独家爆料”，则我方全体造成伤害无视对方8%的防御。
星魂六：我方全体增笑30%，虚照·阿哈欢愉技倍率变为666%。拥有虚照·阿哈“独家爆料”的角色在阿哈时刻开启时行动提前24%。

专属光锥：速度提高18%，我方欢愉技命中敌人后使敌方受到的伤害提高5%三回合（最多4层）。我方角色释放普攻后，速度提高10%三回合（最多一层）。

“独家爆料”特殊效果（谒者）
“火花”：使我方战技点上限+1，火花攻击力提高40%。
“银狼lv.999”：在其释放终结技后，使我方先获得50笑点后失去30笑点，仅限一次。银狼lv. 999释放4次强化普攻后刷新次数。
“星期日”：蒙福者造成伤害时，为星期日回复5点能量，最多可通过该效果回复30点能量，星期日行动后刷新恢复次数。
“绯英”：绯英爆伤增加30%，技能“狐狸老师”“绯色，不乐即斩”无视敌方20%的防御
“不死途”：不死途每释放一次追击，我方全体造成的追加伤害提高10%三回合（最多可叠加三层）
“千冶.刃”：生命值上限提高30%，释放追加攻击后额外回复5点能量。
“真珠”：为“真珠”回复20点能量，拥有珍珠提供的护盾的角色欢愉度提高15%。
“开拓者.欢愉”：为“开拓者.欢愉”回复25点能量，“我说欢愉，你耳朵聋吗？”释放时额外记入50笑点
“虚照·阿哈”：对敌方全体造成250%量子欢愉伤害，同时虚照·阿哈释放5次欢愉技后，立刻创造一个固定为40笑点的特殊阿哈时刻
补：特殊阿哈时刻中不含有虚照·阿哈的欢愉技。
